 Latest Minimum Wage Changes by Country, November 2026 
 The latest Minimum Wage updates across the world in the past month.
 Valeria Tonella & Ayesha Mir Published , Nov 16, 2026 Where have Minimum Wages changed recently?
 As of November 2026, Minimum Wages have recently been revised in Argentina, Guernsey, Peru, and in several Indian states.
 Minimum Wage increases: What’s new 
 Minimum Wages have recently been revised in the following countries, states, and regions:
 Argentina 
 With effect from 1 November 2026.
 The Minimum Wage rates for domestic workers have also been increased.
 Japan 
 The effective dates are different for different prefectures, starting from 1 October 2026 to 2 December 2026. Minimum wages are revised in Tokyo and other regions too.
 Meghalaya, India 
 With effect from 1 October 2026. The new rates are applicable to all scheduled employment in Meghalaya.
 Jharkhand, India 
 With effect from 1 October 2026. The new rates are applicable to all scheduled employment in Jharkhand.
 Chhattisgarh, India 
 With effect from 1 October 2026. The new rates are applicable to all scheduled employment in Chhattisgarh.
 Uttar Pradesh, India 
 With effect from 1 October 2026. The new rates are applicable to all notified scheduled employment in Uttar Pradesh.
 Uttarakhand, India 
 With effect from 1 October 2026. The new rates are applicable to all notified scheduled employment in Uttarakhand.
 Peru 
 With effect from 1 October 2026. The private sector Minimum Wage has been increased.
 United Kingdom, ( Guernsey )
 The minimum wages have been revised in the State of Guernsey (United Kingdom) from 01 October 2026. Minimum wages have increased for adults (aged 18 and over) and young people (aged 16 and 17).

 Visit the WageIndicator global Minimum Wage database . We provide information for 216 countries.

 We also publish Living Wage estimates for 4,000+ regions across 190 countries.
 As of October 2026, 21 out of 188 countries measured have a Minimum Wage higher than the Living Wage. Where does your country fit in? Explore our tool which compares global Minimum and Living Wages.
